instructions: Include hackathons, case competitions, startup pitches, innovation challenges, ideathons and technology contests.
Global events and unknown eligibility are eligible for consideration.
Exclude only when explicit evidence establishes a foreign-school-only restriction or another hard ineligibility.
Distinguish a listing directory, historical announcement and active registration page.
Missing deadline or eligibility means needs verification when otherwise relevant, not automatic rejection.
Do not rate a directory of opportunities as if it were a single open competition. Directories may be useful references but are not actionable events.
An event explicitly finished or with a passed deadline is not an active opportunity, even if historically interesting.
Unknown eligibility is NOT evidence of restriction. An explicit foreign-school-only restriction is a hard exclusion.
Use 9-10 for exceptional actionable opportunities, 7-8 clear active matches, 4-6 uncertain or indirect listings, 0-3 closed or unrelated.
